about: Grammar Classroom questions taught in Chinese (Lana's class in the school; scripts/learning/grammar_questions.gd reads them, scripts/learning/grammar_session.gd plays them; guide: docs/guides/GRAMMAR_CLASS.md). One file per taught language, named by its code in data/languages.json; a language without a file has no class. Each question: 'id' (unique, never reused), 'topic' (a key of 'topics'), 'level' (1 = beginner), 'text' (the sentence in this language with exactly one ___ blank), 'choices' (four different answers in this language; the order here does not matter, desks are shuffled), 'answer' (one of the choices: the answer is the word itself, so shuffling can never change it), 'explain' (one short reason per OTHER language: the player's native language), 'meaning' (optional: the sentence in each other language) and, for Chinese, 'noun' (the words.json key of the noun, so the class uses the game's own word). Every wrong choice must be impossible in that sentence, not just less usual; sentences where two answers work are left out (user decisions 6 Nov 2026: Chinese uses only measure words that are the same in Mandarin and Hong Kong writing; no Simplified Chinese; no made-up answers at runtime). Checked by tools/language_check.gd. Chinese and the Chinese explanations are Claude's draft, awaiting review by a speaker.
